summary: Western Mongol realm that grew out of the 1236–1242 campaign and dominated the Rus' principalities; Tokhtamysh, its khan, fought Timur.
editor_notes: Created once in batch 1 as a shared record (step 2). Summary from the batch 1 profile docs; no span stored until a source for its dates is recorded. Used by: Subutai, Baibars (ally of the Mamluks), Timur. polity_type 'other': the vocabulary has no 'khanate'.
